notes.title: Post-launch patch 1 (10.8.6)
notes.content:
Added main volume slider to option menu
 Added a display for the current version id in the main menu
 Proper gamepad (xbox) support for the main, pause and option menus (especialy resolution dropdown)
 Fix: the light on pods' circular switch now flick properly

Stay tuned for more upcoming releases and patchs.

A huge thanks to all who got the game and their support during developement!

Arkitek,
Kernel Red Games

notes.title: PLAYTEST SESSION #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577574/0498d6548f410fd5df284093a9632a20f69500a5.png

Subscribe from the store page!

Hello everyone!

In this first playtest session, we aim to understand how the game plays for you: your thoughts about the tone, gameplay and visual style.

Atlas Hands is a horror maze about spheres
The game tends to be a unique horror experience in its original approach of gameplay. What we seek the most is the right balance and blend between puzzle solving and thrilling encounters.

Your goal
What is this playtest session for?

 On what configuration are you running the game and does it play smoothly
 How does the main gameplay loop feel
 How the mood, tone and visual style hit you, either good or bad
 Do the very little elements of narrative still made you curious

How to
How can I participate?
Playtest subscription is open to anyone for more than a week. Simply go on the store page to subscribe!

Where do I report my feedback?
Directely from the game pause menu, hit the "Report Feedback" button: it will redirect to the feedback report form. Same goes for a bug if you encounter them. Don't hesitate to fill as much bug reports as it is necessary!

What if I'm having technical issues with the game?
For any trouble or thought regarding technical issues or your feeling about the demo (good, bad, your expectations in the future, etc.), feel free to share it in the dedicated forum of the playtest.

Controller support
Right now, the game is full  xbox controller support, as well as mouse/keyboard.
